learned_rules: A celebrity opening is a performance unit, not a chain of interchangeable keywords.
The same celebrity may remain adjacent when scene, framing, action or performance state changes and the next clause adds information.
A complete short reaction may open or answer, but cannot replace the performance anchor.
A two-star A-B-A return is valid only for an explicit answer, counterpoint, continued round, escalation or payoff.
Packaging text and stickers do not prove a semantic transition.
The first dominant full-screen gameplay frame is a hard scope boundary.
